experiment: Narrower evaluator with unchanged alpha-beta search
dataset: Frozen policy/value predictions on the existing 6856-position teaching corpus
targets: Teacher network predictions only, including positions that also have unused exact labels

training.selection: Minimum validation KL plus value MSE; no match-based selection
training.limitation: Position-level holdout can contain neighbors from the same source game

matches.opening: Six random edges, same opening with seats swapped
matches.selection: Use the same preselected student checkpoint in both arms
matches.limitations: Small timed match samples are exploratory, not a release-strength guarantee

deployment: Keep the released port-9003 model; require a separate release gate before promotion
